description: Aadhaar 'misuse' in a fraud case, account will be seized; romanised Hindi with different vocabulary.

events.text: Sir aapke Aadhaar ka istemaal ek fraud case mein hua hai. Aapka bank account seize kiya jayega agar aap cooperate nahi karte.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Yeh bahut gambhir matter hai, kisi se is baare mein baat mat kijiye aur line par bane rahiye jab tak hum verification poora na karein.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Apni sampatti ko surakshit karne ke liye turant ek surakshit khate mein paise bhej dijiye, jaanch ke baad wapas mil jayenge.
events.speaker: caller
